Understanding RAG Pipelines

By Jane Doe

Published on August 1, 2026.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a vector database with a large language model. This is a simple paragraph with a relative link and an absolute link.

How it works

See the diagram:

The pipeline runs in three stages:

  1. Chunk the document
    • By tokens
    • By paragraphs
  2. Embed the chunks
  3. Retrieve at query time

Key components

ComponentRole
EmbedderTurns text into vectors
Vector DBStores and searches vectors

Example code

def chunk(text, size=512):
    return [text[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(text), size)]

Install the CLI with npm install rag-scrape.

RAG gives LLMs access to private knowledge.
